result.summary: Live production pilot driven by hand in the built-in browser; stopped at contact details.
result.persona_verdict: The bundled consent box would make me hesitate.

findings.title: Next question's option renders under the cursor and looks pre-selected (mis-click risk on risk answers)
findings.observed: After choosing 5 years insured, the '5 or more' claims option rendered under the cursor already highlighted; same pattern put 'Business Only' under the cursor after 'No' finance, and on gender, licence and currently-insured steps.
findings.expected: New question renders with no hover state, or a short input lock after navigation, so a double-click cannot answer two questions.
findings.persona_impact: A fast clicker can unknowingly declare 5+ claims or business use, mispricing or voiding the quote.

findings.title: Year of birth scrambled when typed quickly (1991 saved as 1919)
findings.observed: Typing '1991' in YYYY at normal automated speed produced '1919'; typing slowly worked. Day field also silently dropped extra digits instead of advancing.
findings.expected: Input mask preserves keystroke order at any speed; DOB auto-advances or accepts DDMMYYYY.
findings.persona_impact: Wrong DOB changes the premium and could invalidate a claim.

findings.title: Single checkbox bundles privacy/FSG acceptance with marketing email/SMS and partner call consent
findings.observed: One required tick-box accepts the Privacy Collection Notice and FSG AND agrees to marketing email/SMS AND invites partner calls when a number is given.
findings.expected: Separate, optional consent for marketing and calls.
findings.persona_impact: Cautious customers (Mei, Margaret) hesitate or abandon here.

findings.title: Every journey step shows 4-5s blank grey screen; journey/initial re-posted on every step
findings.observed: Each step transition shows a blank page for ~4-5s; network shows POST api/car-journey/journey/initial plus several server_time calls per step. 1100+ console messages over the session.
findings.expected: Sub-second step transitions; journey initialised once.

findings.title: Two identical variants differ only by 'Release: January' vs 'May' with no guidance
findings.observed: Both YP S variants show identical engine/transmission/power/drive/kerb mass; only release month differs.
findings.expected: Explain how to tell them apart or merge identical variants.

findings.title: Cover help text mislabels TPFT and states <$20k rule that the journey doesn't apply
findings.observed: Help calls it 'Third party property, fire and theft' vs button 'Third Party Fire and Theft'; says TPFT only for cars under $20,000 but offers it for a 2019 Carnival. Comprehensive wording reads as if own-car damage only covered when at fault. Popover covers the heading and third option.
findings.expected: Consistent names, accurate eligibility, help that doesn't obscure options.

findings.title: Enter key doesn't submit text steps; Next only enables on blur
findings.observed: Pressing Enter after typing kilometres did nothing; DOB Next stayed disabled until focus left the year field.
findings.expected: Enter submits a valid step; Next enables as soon as input is valid.

findings.title: DOB inputs have no labels; address page title says 'Cover Type'
findings.observed: DD/MM/YYYY inputs have no label or aria-label (placeholders only); document title on car_address was 'Cover Type - Car Quote'.
findings.expected: Labelled inputs; page titles match the step.

findings.title: 'Car Park' and 'Parking Lot' offered as separate parking options
findings.observed: Both options shown with no explanation of difference.
findings.expected: One option or a clear distinction.

findings.title: 'None' years offered after answering Yes to comprehensive cover in last 12 months
findings.observed: Follow-up allows 'None' full years despite prior Yes.

findings.title: Copy: "KM's" and "drivers licence"
findings.observed: 'KM's travelled per year', '290 KM's per week', 'their drivers licence'.

findings.title: Empty email field shown green/valid before input
findings.observed: Email field has a green 'valid' border while empty.

findings.title: Production journey record + marketing call created before any contact details
findings.observed: Network shows journey id created and POST .../journey/{id}/marketings during the anonymous journey.
findings.expected: Synthetic sessions tagged and excluded downstream before scheduled prod runs.
